description: Land Title Settlement Department - Udumalwatta, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420350
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and land classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property ownership and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
